subject: POC kickoff recap & next steps — Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Harris <jordan.harris@acme.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call — POC scope and next steps

Hi Jordan / Maria,

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned before the kickoff: 

Pain points you confirmed:
- Current search & summarization pipeline has ~2.5s median latency for knowledge-base responses and spikes during peak traffic.
- Cost per query for existing hosted LLMs is higher than expected; wanting predictable unit economics.
- Need auditability for model outputs for compliance reviews.

Goals for the 6-week POC:
1) Reduce median inference latency for KB queries to under 1s for 95% of requests (measured on sample traffic).
2) Cut cost-per-1000-queries by at least 30% with the same output quality.
3) Provide basic output traces and evaluation hooks for 10 representative prompts.

Scope we agreed on:
- Pilot model: open-model variant (redwood-llama-13b-q4) in hosted-dedicated mode for the POC.
- Dataset: 10k doc KB snapshot + 10 canonical prompt templates (Maria will share).
- Success metrics: latency P95, cost tokens/1000, and eval-quality (BLEU/ROUGE + human ratings on 10 prompts).

Owners / points of contact:
- Acme: Jordan Harris (CTO) — exec sponsor, Maria Lopez — data owner / prompt set.
- Redwood: Marissa Cole — commercial lead, Aditya Rao — SE & onboarding, Rishi Malhotra — solutions engineer for evals.

Immediate next steps (action items):
1) Acme: share the 10 prompt templates and a sample KB export (S3 link) by Tue 5/4.
2) Acme: provide IP ranges for allowlist or a short-term SSH tunnel alternative (see allowlist template attached).
3) Redwood: send a draft SOW and onboarding checklist (attached) + schedule the kickoff session for next week.
4) Procurement: we’ll prep a short SOW + DS to speed procurement (looping procurement when ready).

Attachments: Redwood_POC_SOW_v1.pdf, onboarding-checklist.xlsx, network-allowlist-template.txt

If that matches your expectations I’ll lock in a kickoff Wednesday 5/5 at 10am PT and send a calendar invite.

Best,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0126

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and captures everything we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 10 prompt templates: Maria will sanitize and share by EOD Monday (5/3). We’ll include the expected correct answer for evaluation.
- Network: We prefer allowlist but still confirming exact ranges. I’ll send the list by Tue morning. If there’s a blocker we can use a temporary SSH tunnel.
- Cost target: the 30% reduction is a target — we understand tradeoffs with model variants; open to Redwood recommendations.

Confirm kickoff on Wed 5/5 10am PT works for Jordan / Maria. Please send invite.

Jordan

Folks — looping in next steps from an SE/setup perspective. Two quick notes before kickoff: 

1) Access & infra items we’ll need from Acme before onboarding:
   - S3 read-only link to the KB export + a short sample (<= 500 docs).
   - IP allowlist entries OR SSH bastion details.
   - A short list of 3-5 representative traffic patterns (queries per second / payload sizes).

2) Evals & prompt set:
   - We’ll run the prompts through an automated eval harness (BLEU/ROUGE + model similarity) and a quick human ratings pass (3 raters).
   - Please include for each prompt: ground-truth, acceptance threshold, and any length/format constraints.

I attached the onboarding checklist and network-allowlist-template for reference. I’ll own environment setup and initial model tuning; Rishi will run the eval harness and help with prompt engineering.

Thanks — I’ll be on the kickoff to walk through the setup.

--
Aditya Rao

Subject: POC kickoff confirmed — Wed 5/5 10am PT + pre-kickoff checklist

Great — thanks Jordan. Calendar invite sent for Wed 5/5 10am PT (includes a 60-minute agenda). Quick pre-kickoff checklist so we can hit the ground running: 

Before the kickoff (please complete by Tue 5/4):
- [Acme] Share prompt templates + sample KB S3 link (Maria).
- [Acme] Send IP allowlist or confirm SSH tunnel details (Jordan).
- [Redwood] Share hosted POC onboarding doc + initial SOW (done — see attachments).

Draft POC timeline (6 weeks):
- Week 0 (Kickoff): access, S3 ingestion, baseline latency/cost measurement.
- Week 1-2: model tuning + batching/caching configs; run initial evals.
- Week 3-4: iterate on prompt set, regen evals, human rating pass.
- Week 5: prepare final report + run red-team quality checks.
- Week 6: review results and recommended next steps (Dedicated pricing or Private deployment).

Success criteria (recap): latency P95 <1s, cost -30% vs current, eval pass rate >= 80% on acceptance thresholds.

If procurement needs a shorter SOW or contract template to start, procurement@acme.com is CC’ed — happy to provide a templated statement.

See attachments and links in the email. Looking forward to kickoff.

Thanks,

--
